question: Should gateway JSON message/reason fields become locale-dependent in this PR, or should localization stop at final display copy while stable protocol-facing fields remain English/current-shape?
rationale: The PR intentionally localizes gateway-facing message and reason strings, but current repository policy treats protocol and compatibility surfaces as upgrade-sensitive, and code review alone cannot decide whether clients may consume those text fields as contracts.

options.title: Keep Protocol-Facing Fields Stable
options.body: Require the branch to preserve stable gateway message/reason fields and localize only display-layer copy or explicitly display-only payloads.

options.title: Accept Localized Gateway Text
options.body: Maintainers can accept locale-dependent gateway text if they confirm the relevant code/type fields are the only supported client contract.

options.title: Narrow Runtime I18n Scope
options.body: Pause gateway-facing localization and land only the lower-risk runtime/channel copy once the authMode conflict is repaired.

recommendation.title: Keep Protocol-Facing Fields Stable
recommendation.body: Require the branch to preserve stable gateway message/reason fields and localize only display-layer copy or explicitly display-only payloads.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc merged the adjacent billing-copy contract and has recent agent/runtime localization-adjacent history, making them the best available decision owner from the inspected history.
